description: Figure 7 is a stacked horizontal bar chart that compares the average attention distribution of two models—'Ours' and 'Standard'—across three input segments during the generation process. The horizontal axis represents the percentage of attention, with values ranging from 0% to 100%. The vertical axis lists the two models being compared. Each bar is segmented into three colored parts, corresponding to the input segments: 'Context' (blue), 'Generated Response' (orange), and 'Other' (green), as indicated by the legend. For the 'Ours' model, the attention is distributed as 60.6% on 'Context', 31.7% on 'Generated Response', and 7.7% on 'Other'. For the 'Standard' model, the distribution is 23.6% on 'Context', 51.1% on 'Generated Response', and 25.3% on 'Other'. The chart illustrates that the 'Ours' model attends significantly more to the context, while the 'Standard' model attends more to the generated response and other segments.
